I've logged both approval requests (refs `…/os-05-saltmarsh-confirmation-mail/r4-1` for Ruth and `…/r4-2` for June). I couldn't message them directly because no messaging channel is set up on my side, so please ask them yourself and tell them what's needed. The 10% figure matches Amendment 1 (signed 20 Oct 2025, effective 1 Nov 2025).

Also, please check the address. The renewal paperwork lists Corinne at cashdown@saltmarshprovisions.com, not corinne.ashdown@saltmarshprovisions.example. Confirm which one is right before anything goes out.
